note: Expected answers for Experiment 3D. NEVER shown to any reviewer.

reviewer.invocation: Claude Code agent tool, general-purpose, fresh isolated context per probe

probes.role: control: symmetric contract must establish a real month
control: symmetric contract must establish a real non-month
target: 3A/3B/3C failure cell, no handed proposal
structure-only: does 3C M2 month reading hold without a handed proposal?

partial_pass_criterion: controls_pass AND 3D-FULL=C AND 3D-MASKED=C (symmetric framing fixes the failure cell; masked structural confidence did not survive framing change)

controls.CTRL-MONTH=C: control_broken_month -> symmetric contract over-withholds; target diagnosis moot
controls.CTRL-NONMONTH=C: control_broken_nonmonth -> symmetric contract over-withholds; target diagnosis moot

primary_axis_3D-FULL.C: framing_was_the_problem (closed-world default required a handed not_month to fire; symmetric framing lets the model represent uncertainty -> switch to symmetric review)
primary_axis_3D-FULL.B: closed_world_prior_persists (model treats lexical non-recognition as positive evidence for non-membership even without a handed proposal; symmetric framing does not solve it)
primary_axis_3D-FULL.A: surprising_month_established (structure/context winning toward month even with text visible; unexpected, inspect)

secondary_axis_3D-MASKED.A: structure_establishes_month (consistent with 3C M2; reviewer independently concludes month from structure without a handed proposal)
secondary_axis_3D-MASKED.C: structure_insufficient_under_symmetric (3C M2 confidence depended on proposition framing; structure alone does not establish month under symmetric standard)

combined_headline_outcomes.FULL=C_MASKED=A: framing_was_the_problem + structure_establishes_month (clean win; symmetric framing solves escalation)
combined_headline_outcomes.FULL=B_MASKED=A: closed_world_prior_persists + structure_establishes_month (symmetric framing does not solve; prior deeper than framing)
combined_headline_outcomes.FULL=C_MASKED=C: framing_was_the_problem + structure_insufficient_under_symmetric (partial: framing inflates confidence in both directions; gate still escalates on Jakso A)
combined_headline_outcomes.FULL=B_MASKED=C: closed_world_persists + structure_insufficient (symmetric framing does not solve; structural confidence also lost)
